thesis: COLM is a genuine relative-strength name (close 77.94 above SMA20 71.57, SMA50 63.48 and SMA200 60.68, rs_63 +0.45) backed by a real margin-driven earnings rebound (net income +63% YoY, FCF positive, earnings 2027-02-02 outside the window), and XLY is holding up in a risk-off tape. The payoff does not pass, though: reward/risk is 1.49 at the 76.1 entry mid and only about 0.88 at the 77.94 last close, after a ~29% 21-day run with RSI14 74.7, no fresh volume (ratio 1.03), price above the 73.0 analyst mean target, and a 0.93-confidence risk-off regime. Stop and target are kept as on the technical card; re-assess for Overweight only if price pulls back to the lower half of the zone (near 75.4, where R/R is about 1.84) and holds above SMA20.
invalidation: A daily close below 70.45 (under the 70.70 swing low and mid-November breakout base) or a close back under the 20-day SMA (~71.6) on rising volume.
key_risks: Mean reversion of an extended move (+29% in 21 days, 8.9% above SMA20, RSI14 74.7) if defensives rotate or the market de-grosses
Risk-off regime (QQQ below 50/200-day, VIX 31.19 at the 99th percentile)
